newsitem.title: TAIWAN: TAIWAN CENTRAL BANK INJECTS T$8 BLN IN FUND.
newsitem.headline: TAIWAN CENTRAL BANK INJECTS T$8 BLN IN FUND.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank, responding to rising money rates on tight liquidity, injected T$8 billion worth of funds into the banking system through open market operations on Thursday, a central bank official said.
The bank executed a repurchase of negotiable certificates of deposit offered by interested financial institutions with a rate of 8.00-8.25 percent, the official said.
The institutions have the option of repurchasing the NCDs in five days' time, the official said.
The overnight interbank rate closed at 8.748 percent on Wednesday, up from Saturday's 6.277 percent close.
At 0400 GMT, the rate stood at 8.809.
